name: File upload
summary: Use file upload when users must select and submit one or more files from their device.
whenToUse: Use only when a file is necessary and the service cannot obtain the information another way.
Explain accepted formats, size limits and whether multiple files are allowed before the control.
whenNotToUse: Do not ask for a file when users can provide a short answer directly in the service.
Do not rely on the accept attribute or client-side checks as authoritative validation.

anatomy.name: Form group
anatomy.description: Groups the visible label, optional hint, optional error and file input.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: A label associated by for and id tells users what to upload.

anatomy.name: Native file input
anatomy.description: An input type=file keeps browser and assistive-technology selection behaviour.

variants.name: Error
variants.use: Redisplay after a missing, invalid or failed upload with a linked error message.

behaviour: Submit using a form encoding that supports files and validate the received file on the server.
Handle missing, oversized, unsupported and malicious files safely and explain recoverable errors.
The base file input does not require GOV.UK JavaScript.
accessibility: Keep the native input and an associated visible label.
Reference hint and error IDs with aria-describedby in that order.
Do not make drag-and-drop the only way to select a file.
content: Name the document or evidence required rather than using only “Upload a file”.
State accepted formats, maximum size and how to provide an alternative.
Error messages must say whether the user needs a different file, format or size.

htmlExamples.name: Single supporting document
htmlExamples.html: The file must be a PDF, JPG or PNG smaller than 10MB.
